leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland was straightforward but felt repetitive after already joining its coil and duct.

surprise.text: The completed skin both resists water loss and releases sweat; the warm and cool views also showed different vessel responses.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though adding the nerve endings was the only offered combination rather than a meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would probably continue because connecting the finished skin to the body revealed more jobs than its outer barrier alone suggested, although the fittings themselves were fairly predictable.
